title: Brother John here — heavy year, but still full of hope.
paragraphs: Brother John here — heavy year, but still full of hope.

You may not be ending this year the way you imagined.
Some promises unfinished.
Some prayers unanswered.
Some mistakes you wish you could rewind.
But hear this clearly, kapatid: grace did not clock out on you.

God is not waiting for January to love you better.
Jesus doesn’t need a “new year version” of you to stay.
If you’re still breathing, mercy is still working.
If you’re still standing, purpose is still alive.
What shame tried to cancel, Christ is still redeeming.

Don’t measure your life by failures — measure it by the cross.
You’re still here. And God is not done.

“Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed, for His compassions never fail. They are new every morning.”
— Lamentations 3:22–23

Grace and peace, mga kapatid.
Keep fighting the good fight. ✝️🔥
#ScandalToGraceSeries #StillHere #GraceWins #JesusIsEnough
